title: Build 43 distinct bosses, four modes, seven classes and an in-game changelog
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Expands Grave Accord to 43 executable bosses across Quarantine Run, Midnight Circuit, Black Bell Pilgrimage and uncapped Endless Vigil. The new sixteen-fight Pilgrimage draws fifteen unique regulars and one reserved finale from twenty distinct identities. All seven classes, 378 skill nodes, 63 paths, 28 weapons and six different arena footprints remain connected. Adds an in-game dated changelog and keeps the fifteen-page Wiki synchronized with current playable behavior.

New Pilgrimage signatures execute moving cover, stopped/restarted projectiles, removable fences and hive wedges, bounded ice drift, bridge crossings, splitting porcelain cover, neutral valves, harmless ghosts, erased chalk walls, sequenced strings, discrete crow flocks, cleansing seals, an armored core and open salt perimeters. Normal/Brutal phases, map bounds, shared damage and authority/prediction use actual geometry. Protocol 10 adds bounded local protocol-9 migration; signed/online state stays strict. Fixes one-coin income rounding and health-tradeoff boundary snapshots.

Adds twenty original individual themes, 168 drawn boss/crow poses and sixteen props. All 23 earlier PCM masters remain byte-identical. All 36 native returns and exact requests are preserved, including thirteen whole-sheet clipping corrections. Independent audits reconstruct every shipped pixel and verify visible atlas padding.

Validation: 202 rules/history/WebSocket/HTTP/SQL checks, content/fifteen-locale validation, TypeScript and production build. Every new identity launches a real WebSocket room; all Normal/Brutal phases and full route budgets/uniqueness are exercised. Actual browser sampling covers the journal/Arabic navigation and Pallbearer on Ossuary Works. See reviews/runtime-verification.json and separate native/UI/audio reports for exact evidence and limits.

Keep draft and main protected. Seventeen identities, Grand Raid, full Endless-exclusive/secret behavior, complete action/facing art, persistent profiles/mastery/cosmetics, verified rankings, durable online recovery and Windows/LAN packaging remain in development. Human listening, final rendered/device/native-language, WAN, endurance and balance acceptance remain open. Public hosting is still its earlier protocol-4 Site; source/Wiki pushes do not redeploy it.
